## Dochi's Cobblemon Editor
### 0.3.1 Change Log
#### Global
##### Fixed
* Fixed trainer AI missing Mega Evolution ability changes when scoring attacks.
##### Improved
* Improved trainer AI weather choices across moves, switches, and Mega Evolution.
* Improved trainer AI switching to preserve threatened Pokémon that can restore valuable weather.
* Improved doubles AI by weighing Protect's success chance against Earthquake's friendly fire.

Global

Fixed
  • Fixed trainer AI missing Mega Evolution ability changes when scoring attacks.
Improved

  • Improved doubles AI by weighing Protect's success chance against Earthquake's friendly fire.
